about: Scald thaws the frozen Pokemon it hits (cb929abbe: before, only a Fire move did), and Scorching Sands thaws its frozen user as it is chosen (b822ac077: before, a frozen user of it stayed frozen). A level-10 Shuckle, slower than the forced wild level-5 Chansey, is given the two moves in the running battle (teach:); the Chansey knows only Splash. The Chansey is frozen (set:) and stays frozen solid on its own turn, and the Shuckle's Scald after it thaws it, where a thaw of its own would have come before; then the Shuckle is frozen and chooses Scorching Sands, which melts the ice ('melted the ice!', the rule's own line: 'thawed out!' would be the one-in-five thaw of the frozen roll). Seed 4 is one whose frozen rolls keep both frozen, the Chansey on its own turn and the Shuckle as it chooses; with seed 1 the Chansey thaws by itself first. The effect rolls are forced to fail, so neither move burns. The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.

lines: The wild Chansey is frozen solid!
Shuckle’s Scorching Sands melted the ice!
